title: Lecturer on Law
bio: Shane Hebel is a Lecturer on Law at Harvard Law School, where he teaches the Negotiation Workshop. Shane is also the Senior Director of Global Marketing for OraSure Technologies, where he focuses on developing and commercializing diagnostics to improve outcomes related to HIV, Hepatitis C, and substance use disorders, diseases that most burden traditionally marginalized […]
